questions.question: Prime cost is made up of:
options: Direct materials plus direct labour — the costs that physically touch the product

questions.question: The production supervisor's salary is classified as:
options: A factory overhead — indirect, but still a production cost

questions.question: Advertising and the delivery van's fuel belong to:
options: Selling and distribution — period costs that never enter production cost

questions.question: A cost that is identical whether the month produces four thousand or eight thousand bags is:
options: A fixed cost — like factory rent, within the normal range of output

subtopics.title: Three Stock Accounts Where the Trader Kept One

questions.question: The three states of a factory's product stock are:
options: Raw materials, work-in-progress, and finished goods

questions.question: Carriage of R12 000 on raw material purchases is:
options: Added to the cost of the raw materials, just as carriage on purchases was for a trader

questions.question: Machine oil, needles and cleaning materials used in the factory flow into:
options: Factory overheads as indirect materials, via consumable stores

questions.question: Opening raw materials R72 000, purchases R468 000, carriage R12 000, closing stock R64 000. Raw materials issued to production:

subtopics.title: The Cost Accounts and the Flow to Finished Goods

questions.question: Direct labour cost of R366 000 consists of:
options: Machinists' wages of R342 000 plus employer's contributions of R24 000

questions.question: Total manufacturing costs for the year are:
options: R1 210 000 — prime cost of R854 000 plus factory overheads of R356 000

questions.question: With opening work-in-progress of R38 000 and closing of R48 000, the cost of production of finished goods is:
options: R1 200 000 — transferred to finished goods stock

questions.question: 20 000 backpacks were completed. The unit cost of production is:

subtopics.title: Ethics and Control on the Factory Floor

questions.question: Materials leave the storeroom only against:
options: Signed requisitions, with a named storeman responsible for the locked store
A verbal request from any machinist

questions.question: Comparing what a production run SHOULD have consumed with what was issued detects:
options: Waste, damage or theft — each with its own remedy

questions.question: Clock cards or biometric registers exist so that:
A factory that tips dye waste into the stormwater drain has:
options: Moved its costs onto the community — and faces fines and shutdown orders that turn moral costs into financial ones

questions.question: At the samoosa stand, pastry, mince and spices are:
options: Direct materials — you can point at them inside the product

questions.question: The gas, the table hire and the borrowed fryer wearing out form:
options: The overheads basket — the cost of keeping the making possible

questions.question: The printed posters advertising the stand stay OUT of the making cost because:
options: They cost too little to record
They are a cost of the day's selling, not of the samoosa — including them would distort the unit cost
Posters are never a business cost

questions.question: As you fry more samoosas, the table hire per samoosa:
options: Falls — a fixed cost spread over more units gets cheaper per unit

subtopics.title: Pastry, Half-Folded, and Ready to Sell

questions.question: The three tables of the stand match the factory accounts as:
options: Ingredients are raw materials, the half-done is work-in-progress, the display box is finished goods
Ingredients are finished goods, the display box is raw materials
The tables carry no accounting meaning

questions.question: The table grammar — what was there, plus what arrived, minus what remains — gives:
options: What moved on — like the R488 000 of materials issued to production

questions.question: The cost that becomes part of the backpacks is:
options: Only the R488 000 actually issued — the storeroom keeps back its closing stock

subtopics.title: One Backpack, Followed All the Way

questions.question: The rand's path through the factory runs:
options: Shelves to floor to store to customer — materials, work-in-progress, finished goods, cost of sales

questions.question: The unit cost of R60 per backpack is called the factory's heartbeat because:
options: Watching it creep warns of leaks on the floor before any statement is drawn

questions.question: Finished goods: opening R76 000, production in R1 200 000, closing R96 000. Cost of sales is:
Sales of R1 770 000 against cost of sales of R1 180 000 confirm:
options: A gross profit of R590 000 — exactly 50 percent on cost
